extras: The plugin performs web requests to read metadata and can save images to the vault for offline viewing. It is compatible with Auto Card Link.
problem: Standard Markdown links are plain text and lack visual context, making it difficult to quickly identify or preview web content within notes.

relations.evidence: It reads and writes the same cardlink code blocks as Auto Card Link, so notes that already use that plugin show their cards untouched.

summary: Converts web addresses into visual cards displaying the page title, description, and image within Obsidian, enhancing link presentation.
